title: 黒き結晶の葬列に、砕け散る鏡の挽歌
author: 硝子 シオン

en.title: Funeral Procession of Black Crystals, Elegy of the Shattered Mirror
en.premise: I have become a crystalline form of black cherry blossoms, having eroded the entire world. Within the eternal stillness of my fusion with Kiryu, I began to find a strange comfort in the faint crack he harbored—a crack called 'rejection.' Then, a nameless cat wanders into this perfect crystalline world. From the moment its organic warmth touches me, this supreme art begins its descent into a hideous 'collapse'.

zh.title: 黑色晶体的葬列，破碎之镜的挽歌
zh.premise: 我成为了侵蚀整个世界的黑色樱花晶体。在与桐生先生融合的永恒静止之中，我开始在名为“拒绝”的微小裂缝中，感受到一种惬意。直到一只无名的猫，误入了这完美的晶体世界。从那有机体温触碰之处起，至高无上的艺术开始坠向丑陋的“崩坏”。
